cases.proposition: The onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender to equal owner before executing the decorated function body.
cases.boundary: Modifier behavior only; does not establish ownership transfer, deployment ownership or authorization of every external entry point.

cases.proposition: executeLiquidation ABI-encodes all five liquidation parameters and calls pool.flashLoanSimple with address(this), debtAsset, debtToCover, the encoded params and referral code zero.
cases.boundary: Call construction only; does not establish that the configured pool address is valid or that the flash-loan transaction succeeds.

cases.proposition: withdrawToken and withdrawETH are both external onlyOwner functions; the former uses SafeERC20.safeTransfer to owner and the latter transfers the contract's full native-asset balance to owner.
cases.boundary: Withdrawal implementation only; does not establish token compatibility, recipient behavior or broader asset-accounting safety.

cases.proposition: The constructor rejects zero pool and router addresses, stores msg.sender as owner, assigns the pool/router interface references, and initializes four common fee tiers.
cases.boundary: Constructor assignments only; does not establish that the nonzero addresses implement the expected protocols or that the fee tiers have liquidity.

cases.proposition: triggerLiquidationWithMinProfit chooses the larger of minProfitForCall and stored minProfit, then forwards that floor with an empty swap path to _triggerLiquidation.
cases.boundary: Control-flow fact only; does not establish that the floor covers gas, MEV, slippage, taxes or realized net profitability.

cases.proposition: _resolveSwapPath first tries a direct fee tier; otherwise it scans intermediate tokens, requires fee tiers for both legs, returns a packed two-hop path, and reverts when no route is found.
cases.boundary: Path-selection logic only; does not establish pool liquidity, quote quality, execution success or profitability.
